name: Framecut
description: A plain frame with the middle of the cell taken clean out.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 19%, transparent 19%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
